entities.name: Achaemenid Empire
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Achaemenid Empire, a political institution in Turkmenistan during Ancient Margiana and Parthia (550 BCE–247 BCE). Grew from Oxus Civilization and Margiana and Gonur Depe flourishes as a major urban center of the Oxus Civilization. Led to the emergence of Achaemenid Margiana and Parthian Origins and Arsacid Parthian.
